## Current position

**PhD student in mathematics**  
University of Bonn. Supervisor: [Jan Schröer](https://www.math.uni-bonn.de/~schroer/).

## Education

- **MSc in mathematics**, University of Bonn.
- **Part III in Mathematics**, [University of Cambridge](https://www.maths.cam.ac.uk/postgrad/part-iii/current); member of **Magdalene College**.

## Research interests

Representation theory of finite-dimensional algebras, quivers, and their homological and combinatorial properties.
